text:
Alex R: Heads-up — HelioCorp wants the contextual-reranker feature enabled for their prod contract. Need to coordinate allowlist + contract gating before flip.
Maria S: Thanks. Is this going to be a full rollout or canary?
Alex R: Start with a narrow canary: 2% of HelioCorp org traffic, staging -> prod-canary -> full. Contract requires audit logs and IP allowlist.
Pranav K: Who owns the allowlist change? I can add the org IDs but need the exact account IDs + source IP ranges.
Alex R: @Pranav K I pasted the account metadata in the HelioCorp spreadsheet earlier — PM added IP ranges in column F. Link: https://redwood.co/heliocorp-onboarding (internal).
Jess O: Quick CR ping: I added a small change to flag-check middleware to enforce contract entitlements. PTAL: https://git.redwood/infra/flag-middleware/pull/412 — importantly, it rejects if contract_gated=true and not on allowlist.
Pranav K: lgtm but add a unit test for missing entitlement path. Caught one edge otherwise.
Jess O: Added test, pushed.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging rollout at 14:10 UTC, prod-canary at 15:00 UTC. CI passed.
Alex R: Config snippet for the canary I want to use (FYI):
```json
{
  "flag": "contextual_reranker_v2",
  "scope": "org:heliocorp",
  "stages": ["staging","prod-canary"],
  "canary_percent": 2,
  "contract_gate": true,
  "audit_log": "enabled"
}
```
Maria S: Need confirmation from Legal that audit retention meets their compliance. @Sam T can you loop legal?
Sam T: On it. I'll confirm retention window and reply by EOD.
Pranav K: Operational checklist: add org IDs to tenant-allowlist service, patch routing rule, make a quick metric check for latency and error spikes. I can own routing + metrics.
Alex R: Great. Rollback plan: immediate kill on flag server side (0%), and fallback model to baseline-retriever. Jess, moving the fallback mapping in the same PR?
Jess O: Yup, fallback mapping included and tested on staging.

deploy-bot: prod-canary rollout started at 15:00 UTC — 2% traffic to contextual_reranker_v2 for org:heliocorp.
Maria S: Monitoring queries to watch (quick):
- error rate: `service.retriever.errors{flag:contextual_reranker_v2,org:heliocorp}`
- latency p50/p95: `service.retriever.latency.p95{org:heliocorp}`
- quality regression: `evals.quality.delta{test:heliocorp_promptset}`
Alex R: If any of those breach thresholds, @Pranav K do immediate pause and ping the thread.
Pranav K: Will do.
Sam T: Legal confirmed: 90-day audit retention OK, can proceed.
Alex R: Perfect. Maria, Jess — can you both ack readiness so I can mark this customer as green to ops?
Maria S: Ack :white_check_mark:
Jess O: Ack :white_check_mark:
Alex R: Thanks everyone — I'll watch the canary and post a short status update at +30m.
ops-bot: Canary health: 30m check — no errors above threshold, latency within expected range.
Alex R: Status: canary looks good. Requesting prod ramp to 25% for HelioCorp over next hour. Anyone object?
Maria S: No objections from SRE side.
Pranav K: Go ahead. I'll keep metrics on watch.
Alex R: Thanks — proceeding to ramp.
deploy-bot: Ramp started: new target 25% at 16:10 UTC.
ops-bot: Ramp health: all green. :tada:
Alex R: Closing thread — final note: added entries to contract-audit log and tenant-allowlist repo. Docs + rollbooks updated at https://redwood.co/internal/rollbooks/heliocorp-feature-flags
Sam T: Nicely done team.
